mentions.name: Possible World Wikis
mentions.description: A tool that generates fictional wikis using LLMs and procedural generation, enriched with worldbuilding history and context so the generated wiki stays coherent.
mentions.problem: LLM-generated fictional wikis can drift out of coherence without shared worldbuilding history and context.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Possible World Wikis! https://www.possibleworldwikis.com/

LLM/procedurally-generated fictional wikis with worldbuilding history/context so the wiki stays coherent. Fun project to make the most of LLM hallucinations
